title: Arrays and loops
description: Traverse collections and build results incrementally.

lessons.title: The accumulator pattern
lessons.theoryMarkdown: An accumulator stores a result while a loop visits each value. Start from a neutral value, update it once per element, and return it after the loop.

exercises.title: Sum an Array
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Return the sum of every number in the array.
hints: Create a variable for the running total.
Visit every element with a loop.
Add the current element to the total.
